title: The Genuine signature on the page
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：genuine　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 genuine 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the father wrote of ① a genuine signature on the page in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② so genuine that nobody in the house would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the genuine ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the genuine signature on the page that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1975 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too genuine to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the genuine ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a genuine kindness of the stranger, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as genuine as the kindness of the stranger they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was genuine or not, and he said so.

By 1988 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something genuine, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite genuine; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the genuine ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1991, before dawn, she wrote of another genuine signature on the page in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less genuine than anybody had expected. ⑩ The genuine kindness of the stranger that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1993, was the one she could never quite name; the genuine ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 真正（前置定语 a genuine signature on the page：1981 年父亲在家书里记下的那件真正的真迹）
B. adj. 真正／真诚（两处加强说法：so genuine that … 与 no less genuine than …）
C. adj. 真正／真诚（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 真正（表语 too genuine to do：母亲觉得它太真正，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 真诚（前置定语 a genuine kindness of the stranger：叔叔把整件事称作一桩真诚的善意）
F. adj. 真诚（同级比较 as genuine as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩陌生人真诚的善意相比）
G. adj. 真诚（后置定语 something genuine：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 真诚（受程度副词修饰 quite genuine：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: a genuine signature on the page
the genuine signature on the page that
a genuine kindness of the stranger
The genuine kindness of the stranger that

answers.why: genuine 意为“真正”，1981 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件真正的真迹”，此处作前置定语 a genuine signature on the page。
genuine 意为“真正”，此处用 so genuine that 结构，说它真正到老屋里没人敢靠近。
genuine 意为“真正”，家书上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的真正页上的真迹，等于最高级的说法。
genuine 意为“真正”，母亲认为这件东西“太真正了，谁也用不上”，too genuine to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
genuine 意为“真诚”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩真诚的善意”，此处作前置定语 a genuine kindness of the stranger。
genuine 意为“真诚”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩陌生人真诚的善意一样真诚”，同级比较用 as genuine as。
genuine 意为“真诚”，家书上那半行字要的是“真诚的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something genuine。
genuine 意为“真诚”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当真诚”，quite 修饰原级 genuine。
genuine 意为“真诚”，no less genuine than 表示“其真诚不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之真诚不亚于任何人的预料。
genuine 意为“真诚”，母亲 1993 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的真诚善意”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1981 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件真正的真迹。（a genuine signature on the page）
它真正到老屋里没有一个人敢靠近。（so genuine that …）
母亲觉得它太真正，谁也用不上。（too genuine to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩真诚的善意。（a genuine kindness of the stranger）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩陌生人真诚的善意一样真诚。（as genuine as …）
到了 1988 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件真诚的东西。（something genuine）
answers: In 1981 the father wrote of a genuine signature on the page in the letter.
It was so genuine that nobody in the house would go near it.
My mother thought it too genuine to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a genuine kindness of the stranger.
He said nobody would call it as genuine as the kindness of the stranger they had once had.
By 1988 the letter asked for nothing but something genuine.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 genuine 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the father wrote of a genuine signature on the page in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the genuine signature on the page that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too genuine to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a genuine kindness of the stranger, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite genuine, and everybody laughed.
The genuine ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
